question: List the distinct product descriptions purchased at Czech gas stations by LAM customers using EUR whose total consumption in 2013 was greater than in 2012.

    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012
